about_short_description.short_description: Optimal Dynamics is a SaaS company that uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to disrupt the logistics industry.

product.name: Transportation Decision System (TDS)
product.description: A cloud-based platform for truckload carriers that combines network optimization, freight procurement, planning, and dispatch automation to improve utilization, productivity, revenue, and profitability.

product.name: Scale
product.description: An agentic freight procurement and network management system that identifies freight gaps, evaluates opportunities against network needs, and automates sourcing, bidding, negotiating, and procurement.

product.name: Dispatch Management
product.description: A real-time dispatch automation solution that ranks driver-to-load assignments using network, profitability, feasibility, hours-of-service, home-time, and driver-preference constraints.

product.name: Network Simulation
product.description: A digital-twin planning tool that models changes to a carrier’s network and compares projected operational and financial outcomes before implementation.

product.name: Bid Analysis
product.description: A bid planning and analysis solution that identifies suitable lanes and volumes for RFPs and simulates their effects on profitability, coverage, and service.

product.name: Partner Integrations and API Connectivity
product.description: Integration capabilities that connect Optimal Dynamics with transportation management systems, electronic logging systems, and custom applications through two-way data exchange and APIs.
